# Nuada and the industries that were always telling its story

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Nuada** works now.

Nuada's story is the Irish tradition's great parable of kingship and the body: a ruler can be unmade by a single wound and remade by healing, and the law watches both. The record runs from the Lebor Gabála Érenn through the two battles of Mag Tuired, and his Welsh and Gaulish cognates carry the same silver-handed name across the Celtic world.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Nuada
- **Pantheon:** Celtic
- **Domain of influence:** War, King of Tuatha
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Health & Wellbeing · Commerce & Governance
- **Strongest seat:** Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 253 of 397

## The Myth at Work

**The First Battle of Mag Tuired.** When the Tuatha Dé Danann came to Ireland, Nuada had been their king for seven years.  They demanded the country from the Fir Bolg, and the two peoples met at Mag Tuired in Connacht. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**The Silver Hand and the Hand of Flesh.** Because a blemished man could not hold the kingship, Nuada yielded the throne to Bres.  The physician Dian Cécht, with Credne the brazier, made him a full arm of silver that moved in every joint — whence his byname Airgetlám, Silver-hand. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine

*Medicine, pharmaceuticals, and public health. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The silver arm of Dian Cécht and the flesh arm of Miach — medicine that rebuilds the king, at a price.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Legal, Justice & Compliance

*Law, courts, and regulatory compliance. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*The blemish law — the king must be whole; the corpus’s sharpest case study in fitness-for-office.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Defense, Military & Security

*Defense contracting, security services, and strategic studies. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *First king at Mag Tuired — he leads the Tuatha into both their great wars.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

## The Long Employment

Nuada's afterlife runs through scholarship into fantasy.  When R. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in healthcare, pharma & medicine, legal, justice & compliance, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/nuada/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
